title: Wall Mount Multi Hook 6-Position 15.5-Inch Solid Brass - Mercury Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a wall mount multi hook that gives you 6 hanging positions in one compact, coordinated rack.

  • 6-position layout: Helps keep towels, robes, and everyday bath accessories within easy reach
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted from solid brass materials for dependable use
  • Concealed mounting: Hidden screw hardware creates a clean, finished look
  • Wall-mounted design: Uses vertical space to help free up counters and shelves
  • Mercury Collection coordination: Designed to pair with matching transitional bathroom hardware

Specs

  • Collection: Mercury
  • Category: Multi Hooks
  • Style: Contemporary
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Overall dimensions: 15.5 in L x 4 in W x 3.2 in H
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 3 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Multi hook and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finish options: Available in multiple designer finish options (25 finishes, including statement colors)

_previous.description: Maximize your space with this elegant 6 position multi hook from the Mercury Collection. The elegant design of this hook creates a decorative and functional space in any room of your house with a contemporary yet simple touch. This hook is perfect for robes, towel, jackets or just about anything. The multi hook is finished with a lifetime designer finish to insure the beauty of this item will last forever
